profile.name: 哈佛注射泵（Pump 11/PHD2000）
profile.description: 用于精密液体输送的注射泵，可通过串口按地址控制单台或串接泵，设置注射器直径、流速和目标体积，并执行注液、回抽与停止操作，适用于微流控、定量加液和连续流实验。
profile.description_en: A precision syringe pump for liquid delivery, controllable over a serial connection with pump addressing on a daisy chain. It supports setting syringe diameter, flow rate, and target volume, and performing infusion, withdrawal, and stop operations for microfluidics, metered dispensing, and flow experiments.

A precision syringe pump for liquid delivery, controllable over a serial connection with pump addressing on a daisy chain. It supports setting syringe diameter, flow rate, and target volume, and performing infusion, withdrawal, and stop operations for microfluidics, metered dispensing, and flow experiments.
